reply: My ring was stolen by a parrot, directly from my dressing table near the window. It flew to the nearby mountains and I fear my ring will be lost forever. Whoever returns it to me will be rewarded generously. ...
I guess that evil parrot hid the ring somewhere on a high tree or a rock so that you might need a rake to get it.
Oh, my beloved ring! Have you found it and want to return it to me?
I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
Great, thank you! As promised, here are your 5 gold pieces. Is there ... anything left that you might want to discuss with me?
You have returned my ring and proven yourself as trustworthy. There is something I have to discuss with you. Are you willing to listen?
<blushes> Oh, he is so wonderful. A very special man with a special place in my heart.
I can't thank you enough for freeing my beloved Ray from that evil spell. I am still shocked that a mermaid could steal his love that easily.
Oh, thank you so much! Take this gold as a reward. ... which reminds me, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?

Ahh, now I understand... One of my suitors - a real chicken-heart - just brought back my ring. I was really surprised. Suddenly he shows brave attitude. But... It seems you lost it and he tries to take advantage. ...
Thanks a lot anyways and take this gold as a reward. By the way, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
Thank you! It is not a difficult matter but a rather urgent one. I need to send some money to a person in town. Would you be willing to run this small errand for me?

I was hoping that you'd agree. Please deliver these 200 gold pieces to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of the town. If you return from this errand, I will grant you 5 gold pieces as reward for your efforts.

I am glad to hear that. So please listen: Due to circumstances too complicated to explain now, I met Captain Ray Striker. He is ... a freedom fighter and would not find my father's acceptance, but we fell in love ...
Even though he had to hide for a while, we have stayed in contact for a long time now. And our love grew even further against all odds ...
However, recently we lost contact. I don't know what has happened to him and fear the worst ...

We always have been aware that something terrible might happen to him due to his lifestyle. But perhaps there is a harmless explanation for the absence of messages <holds her tears back>. I have arranged a passage for you to Ray's hiding place ...
Contact Captain Waverider, the old fisherman, and tell him the secret word 'peg leg'. He will make sure that you arrive safely ...
Please look for Ray and find out what happened to him and why he was not able to answer. Return to me as soon as you have found something out. I wish you a good journey.
Then no.
Oh, so you brought some gold from Eleonore to me?

Hmm, it seems that Eleonore does trust you. Perhaps she is even right. However. Since we need some help right now I guess we can't be too picky. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: 'peg leg'. She will tell you more about her problem.
You don't have enough...
Then no.
Ohhhh. So... <lowers his voice> you know who sent you so I sail you to you know where. <wink> <wink> It will cost 50 gold to cover my expenses. Is it that what you wish?
Sorry, my old ears can't hear you.
And there we go!
You don't have enough money.
I have to admit this leaves me a bit puzzled.
Eleonore ... Yes, I remember her... vaguely. She is a pretty girl ... but still only a girl and now I am in love with a beautiful and passionate woman. A true {mermaid} even.
Don't ask about silly missions. All I can think about is this lovely {mermaid}.
Ask around in the settlement where you can help out. If you have proven your worth I might have some missions for you.
Indeed, I could use some help. The evil pirates of Nargor have convinced an alchemist from Edron to supply them with a substance called Fafnar's Fire ...
It can burn even on water and is a threat to us all. I need you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire ...
When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'. That should enrage any member of the Edron academy enough to refuse any further deals with the pirates.
I think that means 'mission accomplished'. Hehe. I guess that will put an end to their efforts to buy any alchemical substance from Edron.
The mission on which I will send you is vital to our cause. It is a sabotage mission. Nargor is guarded by several heavy catapults. ...
I need you to sabotage the most dangerous of those catapults which can be found right in their harbour, aiming at ships passing by the entrance. ...
Get a fire bug - you can buy them in Liberty Bay - and set this catapult on fire. ...
Make sure to use the bug on the left part of the catapult where its lever is. That is where it's most vulnerable. ...
If you see a short explosion, you will know that it worked. I will tell Sebastian to bring you to Nargor, but beware. ...
Of course, he can't drop you off directly in the pirate's base. However, we have discovered a secret way into the Howling Grotto. ...
Try to make your way through the caves of Nargor to reach their harbour. This is where you will find the catapult in question.
You did it! Excellent!
If you manage to accomplish this vital mission you will prove yourself to be a worthy member of our community. Imight even grant you your own ship and pirate clothing! ...
So listen to the first step of my plan. I want you to infiltrate their base. Try to enter their tavern, which meansthat you have to get past the guard. ...
You will probably have to deceive him somehow, so that he thinks you are one of them. ...
In the tavern, the pirates feel safe and plan their next strikes. Study ALL of their maps and plans lying around ...
Afterwards, return here and report to me about your mission.
Well done, my friend. That will help us a lot. Of course there are other things to be done though. ...
I learned that Klaus, the owner of the tavern, wants me dead. He is offering any of those pirates a mission to kill me....
If we could convince him that you fulfilled that mission, the pirates will have the party of their lives. This would beour chance for a sneak attack to damage their boats and steal their plunder! ...
Obtain this mission from him and learn what he needs as a proof. Then return to me and report to me about yourmission so we can formulate an appropriate plan.
My pillow?? They know me all too well... <sigh> I've owned it since my childhood. However. Here, take it and convincehim that I am dead.
Incredible! You did what no other did even dare to think about! You are indeed a true hero to our cause ...
Sadly I have no ship that lacks a captain, else you would of course be our first choice. I am still true to my word asbest as I am able. ...
So take this as your very own ship. Oh, and remind me about the pirate outfit sometime.

The mermaid is the most beautiful creature I have ever met. She is so wonderful. It was some kind of magic as we first met. A look in her eyes and I suddenly knew there would be never again another woman in my life but her.
I am deeply ashamed that I lacked the willpower to resist her spell. Thank you for your help in that matter. Now my head is once more free to think about our {mission}.
<giggles> I think he has a crush on me. Well, silly man, it is only for his own good. This way he can get accustomed to TRUE beauty. And I won't give him up anymore now that he is mine.
Is that the best you can do? A true Djinn would have done something more poetic.
This lovely, exotic Djinn is a true poet. And he is asking me for a date? Excellent. Now I can finaly dump this human pirate. He was growing to be boring more and more with each day ...
As a little reward for your efforts I allow you to ride my sea turtles. Just look around at the shores and you will find them.
I heard the birds sing about her beauty. But how could a human rival the enchanting beauty of a {mermaid}?
Oh yes, I noticed that lovely mermaid. From afar of course. I would not dare to step into the eyes of such a lovely creature. ...
... I guess I am quite shy. Oh my, if I were not blue, I would turn red now. If there would be someone to arrange a {date} with her.
Oh my. Its not easy to impress a mermaid I guess. Please get me a {love poem}. I think elves are the greatest poets so their city seems like a good place to look for one.
Will you ask the mermaid Marina if she would date me?
Thank you. How ironic, a human granting a djinn a wish.
Excellent. Here, with this little spell I enable you to recite the poem like a true elven poet. Now go and ask her for a date again.
You don't have it...
Did you get a love poem from Ab'Dendriel?
Do you want to buy a poem scroll for 200 gold?
Here it is.
You don't have enough money.
You know, we have plenty of rum here but we lack some basic food. Especially food that easily becomes mouldy is a problem. Bring me 100 breads and you will help me a lot.
Are you here to bring me the 100 pieces of bread that I requested?
The sailors always tell tales about the famous beer of Carlin. You must know, alcohol is forbidden in that city. ...
The beer is served in a secret whisper bar anyway. Bring me a sample of the whisper beer, NOT the usual beer but whisper beer. I hope you are listening.
Did you get a sample of the whisper beer from Carlin?
What a joy. At least for a few days adequate supply is ensured.
You don't have enough bread.
Thank you very much. I will test this beauty in privacy.
Whatever you got there is not whisper beer.
Hurry up then! I can't wait to taste it.
Hm, if you are that eager to work I have an idea how you could help me out. A distant relative of mine, the old sage Eremo lives on the isle Cormaya, near Edron. ...
He has not heard from me since ages. He might assume that I am dead. Since I don't want him to get into trouble for receiving a letter from a pirate I ask you to deliver it personally. ...
Of course it's a long journey but you asked for it. You will have to prove us your worth. Are you up to that?
Thank you for delivering my letter to Eremo. I have no more missions for you.
Alright, we will see. Here, take this letter and deliver it safely to old Eremo on Cormaya.
A letter from that youngster Morgan? I believed him dead since years. These news are good news indeed. Thank you very much, my friend.

I need a new quality atlas for our captains. Only one of the best will do it. I heard the explorers society sells the best, but only to members of a certain rank. You will have to get this rank or ask a high ranking member to buy it for you.
Did you get an atlas of the explorers society as I requested?

You did some impressive things. I think people here start considering you as one of us. But these are dire times and everyone of us is expected to give his best and even exceed himself. Do you think you can handle that?
Did you rescue one of those poor soon-to-be baby tortoises from Nargor?
Indeed, what a fine work... the book I mean. Your work was acceptable all in all.
You don't have it...
I am glad to hear this. Please listen. The pirates on Nargor are breeding tortoises. They think eating tortoises makes a hard man even harder. ...
However I am quite fond of tortoises and can't stand the thought of them being eaten. So I convinced Captain Striker that I can train them to help us. As a substitute for rafts and such ...
All I need is one tortoise egg from Nargor. This is the opportunity to save a tortoise from a gruesome fate! ...
I will ask Sebastian to bring you there. Travel to Nargor, find their tortoise eggs and bring me at least one of them.
A real tortoise egg ... I guess you are more accustomed to rescue some noblewoman in distress but you did something goodtoday.
A real tortoise egg ... I guess you are more accustomed to rescue some noblewoman in distress but you did something goodtoday.
You don't have it...
Then no.
Maybe next time.
The evil cult has placed a curse on one of the captains here. I need at least five of their pirate voodoo dolls to lift that curse.
Did you bring five pirate voodoo dolls?
Finally I can put an end to that curse. I thank you so much.
You don't have it...
This is really not advisable. Behind this barrier, strong forces are raging violently. Are you sure that you want to go there?
I guess I cannot stop you then. Since you told me about my apprentice, it is my turn to help you. I will perform a ritual for you, but I need a few ingredients. ...
Bring me one fresh dead chicken, one fresh dead rat and one fresh dead black sheep, in that order.
Very good! <mumble> 'Your soul shall be protected!' Now, I need a fresh dead rat.
You don't have the necessary items.
Very good! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Now, I need a fresh dead black sheep.
You don't have the necessary items.
Very good! <stomps staff on ground> 'EVIL POWERS SHALL NOT KEEP YOU ANYMORE! SO BE IT!'
You don't have the necessary items.
You should not talk about things you don't know anything about.
You mean, you are interested in a counterspell to cross the energy barrier on Goroma?
Did you bring the fresh dead chicken?
Did you bring the fresh dead rat?
Did you bring the fresh dead black sheep?
Hm. I don't think you need another one of my counterspells to cross the barrier on Goroma.
Ah, thank you very much! I'll honour his memory.
You don't have the necessary items.
Ah, the energy barrier set up by the cult is maintained by lousy magic, but it's still effective. Without a proper counterspell, you won't be able to pass it.
Pssht, not that loud. So they have sent you to get... the stuff?
Finally. You have no idea how difficult it is to keep something secret here. And you brought me all the crystal coins I demanded?
exclude_keywords: your continued existence is payment enough

keywords: your continued existence is payment enough
reply: What?? How dare you?! I am a sorcerer of the most reknown academy on the face of this world. Do you think some lousy pirates could scare me? Get lost! Now! I will have no further dealings with the likes of you!
Do you want to sail Nargor for 50 gold coins?
Sorry, but I can't take you there.
Set the sails!
Hey, I rarely see a dashing pirate like you! Get in, matey!
YOU WILL NOT PASS! Erm ... I mean you don't look like a true pirate to me. You won't get in.
Hmm, you look like a seasoned seadog. Kill Captain Ray Striker, bring me his lucky pillow as a proof and you are our hero!
Do you have Striker's pillow?
You DID it!!! Incredible! Boys, lets have a PAAAAAARTY!!!!
Come back when you have his lucky pillow.
I'd love to bring you back to Liberty Bay, but as you can see, my ship is ruined. I also hurt my leg and can barely move. Can you help me?
Have you brought 30 pieces of wood so that I can repair the ship?
Do you want to travel back to Liberty Bay?
Thank you. Luckily the damage my ship has taken looks more severe than it is, so I will only need a few wooden boards. ...
I saw some lousy trolls running away with some parts of the ship. It might be a good idea to follow them and check if they have some more wood. ...
We will need 30 pieces of wood, no more, no less. Did you understand everything?
Good! Please return once you have gathered 30 pieces of wood.
Excellent! Now we can leave this godforsaken place. Thank you for your help. Should you ever want to return to this island, ask me for a passage to Goroma.
You don't have enough...
Set the sails!
